about.heading: Curious about data, systems, and everything in between.
paragraphs: My name is Disu Ibukunoluwa. I'm a recent First Class Computer Science graduate from Covenant University and an emerging Data Engineer. I work with SQL, Python, and data visualisation tools, with experience in data modelling, dashboard design, and root-cause analysis that supports informed decision-making.

I became interested in data because it can help us understand what happened, see what is happening now, and spot patterns that might shape what happens next. That range of possibilities is what first sparked my curiosity.

But data doesn't become useful just because it exists. It has to be collected, organised, processed, stored, and made accessible. That's what draws me to Data Engineering: building the systems that connect information to the decisions people need to make.

When I'm not writing SQL or debugging code, I enjoy public speaking, debate, reading, and bringing people together to make ideas happen. I'm also fascinated by the universe and love falling down a rabbit hole whenever something catches my interest.

Those interests influence how I approach engineering. They've taught me to ask better questions, explain ideas clearly, and think about the people relying on a system. I'm always curious, always learning, and always looking for the next problem worth solving.
If you're into data, AI, or just want to talk about the universe over coffee, I'd love to connect!
